content: Hazel (Noodlesoft manual): per-folder ordered rules of conditions + actions; first matching rule wins unless 'Continue matching rules'; a rule that matched a file won't re-apply on later passes (idempotency memory); top-level only unless subfolder rule; rule preview shows which files match and why; Hazel 6 adds error highlighting on save, undo of rule changes via Finder contextual menu, pause action; built-in folder options throw away duplicate (name-suffix) downloads and incomplete downloads, and Trash auto-empty after N days. macOS Tahoe Shortcuts folder automations: Added/Modified/Removed triggers, Ignore Subfolders, Run Immediately vs after confirmation, Notify When Run; filtering left to the shortcut.
